newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin and Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn expected to present their proposals for Europe, including improved co-ordination of policies for employment and growth, at a summit in Poitiers with their German counterparts Helmut Kohl and Theo Waigel.
-- Banking commission seeks to save Banque Finindus, which posted a 622.8 million franc loss for 1996 on shareholder equity of 430 million francs. The bank is to be put up for sale.
-- Swedish group Electrolux to cut some 12,000 jobs and shut down some 25 plants in massive restructuring.
-- Unions at Renault to meet with independent expert appointed by the board to explore alternative solutions to the planned shutdown of the Vilvoorde assembly plant.

-- A premature shutdown of the Superphenix fast-breeder reactor would cost French state utility EDF six billion francs, according to one estimate. The total cost of a shutdown planned for the year 2020 was estimated at around 20 billion francs.
